title.narrative: Strengthening HIV prevention and reduction of Tuberculosis morbidity and mortality - Botswana (01-Jan-2019-31-Dec-2021)

description.narrative: Botswana, TB/HIV, Botswana-Ministry of Health (Ministry of Health)This program has the following goals: To end the Tuberculosis Epidemic. Zero new HIV infections, Zero AIDS related deaths and Zero discrimination by 2030. The objectives of this program are: To reduce mortality of all forms of TB by 50% by 2022;. To reduce the incidence of all forms of TB by 30% by 2022. To achieve 95% of all people with HIV knowing their HIV status by 2023. To reduce number of new infections of HIV among young people and adults by 90% by 2023. To reduce the number of new infections among children (under 15 years) by 95% 2023. To expand ART coverage to 95% of all children, adolescents, young people and adults living with HIV on Treatment by 2023 through treat all strategy. To ensure 95% of Adolescents and Youth living with HIV who know their status are put on ART by 2023
